newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic stent-graft approved in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic stent-graft approved in Europe.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Wednesday its Medtronic AneuRx subsidiary received Conformit Europene (CE) Mark clearance for its endovascular stent-graft system used in the treatment of abdominal aortic aneurysms.
The CE Mark allows the company to market its implantable stent-graft system in all countries of the European Union and the European Free Trade Area.
Medtronic AneuRx is training physicians at selected European cities and expects full commercial release in Europe by the end of 1997, the company said.

"Early clinical results are very encouraging and our CE Mark will enable us to expand availability of the product commensurate with product performance," B. Kristine Johnson, president of Medtronic's Vascular Business, said in a statement.

Medtronic said its stent-graft system allows physicians to treat aortic aneurysms by deploying the system through a catheter placed in the femoral artery. This offers a less-invasive alternative to an open abdominal surgical operation.

In the United States, the Medtronic AneuRx stent-graft system is being evaluated at clinical centers under an investigational device exemption from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, the company said.
